name: Prostitute Jesus
overview: The passages in Matthew and Luke depict Jesus engaging with individuals considered sinners by society, such as the woman who brought ointment to anoint Him in a Pharisee's house, highlighting His compassion and willingness to associate with the marginalized. Jesus' teaching in the temple and His presence in Bethany demonstrate His active ministry among diverse groups. These accounts, together with the affirmation in Ephesians that salvation is by grace through faith, underscore that Jesus offers forgiveness and restoration to all, regardless of past sins.
